title: UK takes down online pensions services following cyber incident
excerpt: The UK government temporarily disabled Department for Work and Pensions online services as a precaution after a cyber incident.
body_html:
The United Kingdom government temporarily took down its online pensions services after experiencing what officials described as a cyber incident.

As a precautionary measure, authorities decided to switch off the online services operated by the Department for Work and Pensions. The government has not yet provided further details regarding the nature of the incident or potential data impacts while addressing the situation.
